commitPolicy: The run-record file is committed last, so its own commit hash is intentionally represented as SELF; final external run summary records the resulting branch HEAD.

implementationCommits.message: qa: bind glazing gasket state into reflection evidence
qa: require glazing gasket validation during probe sync

priorityReasoning.selectedGap: The previous run added a scene-save-built facade glazing gasket and MainCamera native-4K pre-cull validation, but ReflectionProbe.RenderProbe does not invoke MainCamera pre-cull. The central reflection-lighting fingerprint validated materials, facade build, foliage and balcony state but did not explicitly validate the new glazing-gasket assembly. A probe could therefore begin from a missing or drifted gasket state and later still frames could validate a different state.
priorityReasoning.whyBeforeMoreExpansion: The new gasket exists specifically to improve the glass-to-sash contact/interface visible in facade_center, construction_depth and sash_rail_response. Reflection mismatch would undermine the lighting/reflection and material evidence for the same high-value detail. Binding the assembly to the already-central request/poll/completion/pre-still fingerprint closes that coherence gap without speculative new scene content.
priorityReasoning.renderPointPolicy: No Visual Fidelity points are awarded. Structural/material coherence at probe time does not prove that the gasket looks proportionate, physically plausible, non-repetitive or temporally stable in actual pixels.

staticChecks: QualityBlockReflectionLightingStateFingerprint.BuildCurrentSha256 calls QualityBlockReflectionMaterialPhysicalityBindingQA.ValidateOpenScene before hashing the render/probe state.

The reflection binding now calls QualityBlockFacadeGlazingGasketUpgrade.ValidateContractConfigOnly from its config path and QualityBlockFacadeGlazingGasketUpgrade.ValidateOpenScene from its runtime scene path.
The binding contract requires the canonical glazing-gasket contract path, per-fingerprint validation, read-only in-flight behavior and fail-closed abort semantics.
The reflection binding still awards zero Visual Fidelity points and does not claim runtime render verification.
All changed implementation paths are below UnityProject; Godot was not modified.
No base merge was performed; compare merge-base remained the starting HEAD.

expectedImpactOnlyNotAwarded.geometryConstruction: LOW_TO_MODERATE: prevents probe/still evidence from representing different glass-to-sash construction states
expectedImpactOnlyNotAwarded.materialPbr: MODERATE: requires the canonical EPDM/glazing-interface material state before each formal reflection fingerprint
expectedImpactOnlyNotAwarded.lightingShadowsReflections: MODERATE: prevents a realtime cubemap from sealing against stale/missing gasket geometry that later camera frames reject
expectedImpactOnlyNotAwarded.textureMicrodetail: LOW: preserves the gasket metric-UV/phase state indirectly through its full assembly validator
expectedImpactOnlyNotAwarded.temporalLodAliasing: LOW: coherence only; actual LOD pop/shimmer remains pixel-only

renderRisksToInspect: The 10 mm gasket can still read as an over-dark painted halo despite valid construction metadata.
Glass/gasket/sash contact can still reveal interpenetration, a hairline void or z-fighting in oblique/grazing pixels.
The dry EPDM response can still be too glossy or too flat once actual sky/sun/probe response is visible.
Eight UV phase bins can still reveal synchronized repetition across 60 panes.
LOD2/LOD3 narrow front-ring proxies can still shimmer or cross-fade visibly at subpixel width.
